product_one_liner.value: Speak_ is an AI resume-screening and candidate-scoring assistant for recruiters and hiring teams, evaluating applicants against custom criteria called Signals to surface qualified candidates and explain candidate fit.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes AI review of resumes, custom Signals, and candidate insights for recruiters.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage has a public pricing section with Free, Pro, and Enterprise plans.

named_customers.notes: All three are named in customer testimonials on the company homepage.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 18 employees, which falls in the 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies Boulder, Colorado, United States as its headquarters location.

founded_year.notes: The founder's interview states December 21, 2021; LinkedIn also lists 2021.

eng_blog.notes: The index contains recruiting, interview, candidate-story, and career/DEI material, not engineering posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation/footer has no Docs or Help link and the site has a single FAQ section rather than a multi-article product documentation portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Speak_'s Wellfound job page explicitly says it has not added any jobs yet.

model_provider.notes: The product FAQ, privacy policy, and blog do not publicly name an AI model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy names GDPR/UK GDPR, but does not state that Speak_ holds a formal GDPR certification; it names no SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or PCI DSS claim.

last_funding.notes: CB Insights reports the latest round as a $120,000 Seed on March 5, 2025; another database lists an earlier January 2025 accelerator entry without an amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest reported funding round was March 5, 2025, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The company's job-board page says it has not added any jobs yet.

launched_6mo.notes: The latest dated new-product launch located was February 2024, before the window. The Updates index lists an Enhanced Candidate Matching item without a publication date, so it does not establish a launch during May 9-November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Andrea Guendelman's profile lists her Speak_ Founder role ending in January 2026 and a Board Member role beginning January 2026; the About page identifies her as Co-founder & CEO, so the profile suggests an executive transition but conflicts with the company page's current title.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable integration information names ATSs (Ashby, Lever, Greenhouse, and Workable), but no CRM or sales/marketing system.
